name: connect-to-vpn
title: Connect to VPN
description: Control your macOS VPN connections from Raycast and the menu bar, with favorites and a hotkey to toggle your last-used VPN.
author: rasmusbe

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Toggle Last Used
commands.subtitle: Connect to VPN
commands.description: Connect to or disconnect from the VPN most recently selected or used in this extension. Assign a hotkey for quick access.

commands.name: index
commands.title: Show Network Services
commands.subtitle: Connect to VPN
commands.description: View VPN connection status, connect or disconnect, organize favorites, and choose the VPN used by Toggle Last Used.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Network Services
commands.subtitle: Connect to VPN
commands.description: View VPN connection status and connect or disconnect from the menu bar. Status refreshes automatically every 30 seconds.

preferences.name: hideInvalidDevices
preferences.title: Filter Services
preferences.description: Show only available VPN services. Turn off to include disabled VPNs and other network services.
preferences.label: Hide unavailable and non-VPN services

preferences.name: sortBy
preferences.title: Sort By
preferences.description: Sort services by name or type. Active services appear first; favorites keep their manual order.
